```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(htmltools)
library(tigris)
library(spdep)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
#Loading data
ohio_grid   <- readRDS("data/ohio_10km_grid.rds")
zf_breeding <- readRDS("data/ebird_breeding_raptors.rds")
```

```{r}
# projecting ebird points to match grid crs
zf_sf <- zf_breeding %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(ohio_grid))

# assign each checklist to a grid cell
zf_gridded <- st_join(zf_sf, ohio_grid, join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(grid_id))

# count unique species (richness) per cell
richness <- zf_gridded %>%
  filter(species_observed == 1) %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n_distinct(common_name), .groups = "drop")

# join to grid
grid_rich <- ohio_grid %>%
  left_join(richness, by = "grid_id") %>%
  mutate(n_species = replace_na(n_species, 0))


head(richness)
```

```{r}
# downloading ohio counties
ohio_counties <- counties(state = "OH", cb = TRUE, year = 2024) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(ohio_grid))

# joining ebird points to counties
zf_county <- zf_sf %>%
  st_join(ohio_counties, join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GEOID))

# count unique species (richness) per county
county_richness <- zf_county %>%
  filter(species_observed == 1) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n_distinct(common_name), .groups = "drop")

# join back to county polygons
ohio_counties <- ohio_counties %>%
  left_join(county_richness, by = "GEOID")

head(county_richness)
head(ohio_counties)
```
```{r}
library(vegan)

# calculate detection counts per species per county
species_counts <- zf_county %>%
  filter(species_observed == 1) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, common_name) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = common_name, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

# calculate shannon index per county : remove the geoid column and pass it to diversity function. it applies shannon formula to each row and each county gets shannon H value. 
shannon_vals <- species_counts %>%
  select(-GEOID) %>%
  diversity(index = "shannon")

#Create dataframe
shannon_df <- data.frame(
  GEOID   = species_counts$GEOID,
  shannon = round(shannon_vals, 3)
)

#Join back to spatial data
ohio_counties_shannon_plot <- ohio_counties %>%
  left_join(shannon_df, by = "GEOID")

#shanon diveristy map
ggplot(ohio_counties_shannon_plot) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = shannon), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Shannon\ndiversity") +
  labs(title = "Raptor Shannon diversity by county") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12)

ggsave("plots/county_shannon_map.png", width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
head(species_counts)
head(shannon_df)
```

```{r}
#Global Moran Analysis
# projected crs for neighbor calculations
ohio_counties_proj <- ohio_counties_shannon_plot %>%
  st_transform(5070) %>%
  filter(!is.na(shannon))
 
# queen contiguity neighbors
nb <- poly2nb(ohio_counties_proj, queen = TRUE)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# global moran to see if there is spatial autocorrelation
moran.test(ohio_counties_proj$shannon, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# local moran
lisa_results <- localmoran(ohio_counties_proj$shannon, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
ohio_counties_proj$local_moran_i <- lisa_results[, 1]
ohio_counties_proj$local_p_value <- lisa_results[, 5]

# deviation of each county from the state mean
shannon_deviation  <- ohio_counties_proj$shannon - mean(ohio_counties_proj$shannon, na.rm = TRUE)

# average deviation of each county's neighbors from the state mean
neighbor_deviation <- lag.listw(lw, shannon_deviation, zero.policy = TRUE)

# assign LISA quadrants
ohio_counties_proj$lisa_quadrant <- ifelse(shannon_deviation > 0 & neighbor_deviation > 0, "HH",
                                    ifelse(shannon_deviation > 0 & neighbor_deviation < 0, "HL",
                                    ifelse(shannon_deviation < 0 & neighbor_deviation > 0, "LH",
                                    ifelse(shannon_deviation < 0 & neighbor_deviation < 0, "LL",
                                           NA))))

# mark non-significant counties
ohio_counties_proj$lisa_quadrant[ohio_counties_proj$local_p_value > 0.05] <- "Not significant"

head(lisa_results)
```

```{r}
lisa_colors <- c(
  "HH"              = "#d7191c",
  "HL"              = "#fdae61",
  "LH"              = "#abd9e9",
  "LL"              = "#2c7bb6",
  "Not significant" = "#e0e0e0"
)

ggplot(ohio_counties_proj) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_quadrant), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lisa_colors, name = "LISA quadrant") +
  labs(title = "LISA clusters of raptor Shannon diversity by county") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12)

```
```{r}
# reproject to WGS84 (EPSG 4326)
ohio_counties_lisa_wgs <- ohio_counties_proj %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# define color for each LISA quadrant category
pal_lisa <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#abd9e9", "#2c7bb6", "#e0e0e0"),
  levels  = c("HH", "HL", "LH", "LL", "Not significant")
)

#popup text for each county
popups_lisa <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s</strong><br/>LISA quadrant: %s<br/>p-value: %.4f",
  ohio_counties_lisa_wgs$NAMELSAD,
  ohio_counties_lisa_wgs$lisa_quadrant,
  ohio_counties_lisa_wgs$local_p_value
) %>% lapply(HTML)

# Leaflet map
leaflet(ohio_counties_lisa_wgs) %>%

  #background tile options
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron,  group = "Light") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap,       group = "Topographic") %>%

  #county polygons colored by LISA quadrant
  addPolygons(
    fillColor   = ~pal_lisa(lisa_quadrant),  # color by quadrant category
    fillOpacity = 0.8,                        
    color       = "white",                    
    weight      = 0.5,                        
    popup       = popups_lisa,                # click to show county info
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight      = 2,           
      color       = "#333",      
      fillOpacity = 0.9,         
      bringToFront = TRUE        
    )
  ) %>%

  # add legend
  addLegend(
    pal      = pal_lisa,
    values   = ~lisa_quadrant,
    title    = "LISA quadrant",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%

  #layer switcher button
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Light", "Satellite", "Topographic"),
    options    = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Dominant land cover type and scpecies composition map 

#load NLCD raster
nlcd <- rast("~/Spatial raptors project /Annual land cover data 2005-2024/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1.tif")

# load ohio counties
library(tigris)
ohio_counties <- counties(state = "OH", cb = TRUE, year = 2024)

# reproject counties to match NLCD
ohio_counties_proj <- ohio_counties %>%
  st_transform(crs(nlcd))

# crop NLCD to ohio
nlcd_ohio <- crop(nlcd, ext(vect(ohio_counties_proj))) #ext gets the bounding box 

# extract land cover proportions per county
ohio_counties_proj$forest_prop <- exact_extract(
  nlcd_ohio, ohio_counties_proj,
  fun = function(values, cov_frac) {
    sum(cov_frac[values %in% c(41, 42, 43)], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cov_frac)
  })

ohio_counties_proj$ag_prop <- exact_extract(
  nlcd_ohio, ohio_counties_proj,
  fun = function(values, cov_frac) {
    sum(cov_frac[values %in% c(81, 82)], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cov_frac) # 81 is hay/pasture, 82 is cultivated crop
  })

ohio_counties_proj$urban_prop <- exact_extract(
  nlcd_ohio, ohio_counties_proj,
  fun = function(values, cov_frac) {
    sum(cov_frac[values %in% c(21, 22, 23, 24)], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cov_frac)
  })

ohio_counties_proj$wetland_prop <- exact_extract(
  nlcd_ohio, ohio_counties_proj,
  fun = function(values, cov_frac) {
    sum(cov_frac[values %in% c(90, 95)], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cov_frac) #90 is woody wetland and 95 herbaceous wetland
  })

# determine dominant land cover per county
ohio_counties_proj <- ohio_counties_proj %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    dominant = c("Forest", "Agriculture", "Urban", "Wetland")[
      which.max(c(forest_prop, ag_prop, urban_prop, wetland_prop))
    ]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

head(ohio_counties_proj %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
       select(NAME, forest_prop, ag_prop, urban_prop, wetland_prop, dominant))
```

```{r}
#Top 3 species each county
top_species_per_county <- zf_county %>%
  filter(species_observed == 1) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, common_name) %>%
  summarise(detections = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  arrange(desc(detections)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%               #three most frequenty detected species for each county
  summarise(
    top_species = paste0(
      common_name, " (", detections, ")",
      collapse = "<br/>"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# join to counties
ohio_counties_final <- ohio_counties_proj %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  left_join(top_species_per_county, by = "GEOID")

head(top_species_per_county)
head(ohio_counties_final)
```

```{r}
#Define colors for land-cover classes
land_colors <- c(
  "Forest"      = "#1d8348",   # green
  "Agriculture" = "#f1c40f",   # yellow
  "Urban"       = "#c0392b",   # red
  "Wetland"     = "#2980b9"    # blue
)

pal_land <- colorFactor(
  palette = unname(land_colors),
  levels  = c("Forest", "Agriculture", "Urban", "Wetland"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

popups_combined <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s County</strong><br/>
   <strong>Dominant cover:</strong> %s<br/>
   <strong>Forest:</strong> %.0f%%<br/>
   <strong>Agriculture:</strong> %.0f%%<br/>
   <strong>Urban:</strong> %.0f%%<br/>
   <strong>Wetland:</strong> %.0f%%<br/><br/>
   <strong>Top 3 raptor species:</strong><br/>%s",
  ohio_counties_final$NAME,
  ohio_counties_final$dominant,
  ohio_counties_final$forest_prop * 100,
  ohio_counties_final$ag_prop * 100,
  ohio_counties_final$urban_prop * 100,
  ohio_counties_final$wetland_prop * 100,
  ifelse(is.na(ohio_counties_final$top_species),
         "No data",
         ohio_counties_final$top_species)
) %>% lapply(HTML)

leaflet(ohio_counties_final) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap, group = "Topographic") %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor   = ~pal_land(dominant),
    fillOpacity = 0.65,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 1,
    popup       = popups_combined,
    label       = ~paste0(NAME, " — ", dominant),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2, color = "#333",
      fillOpacity = 0.85, bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal      = pal_land,
    values   = ~dominant,
    title    = "Dominant land cover",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Light", "Satellite", "Topographic"),
    options    = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
